name: GM CCA - Fort Worth Parts Distribution Center, Fort Worth TX

fieldNotes.identity: GM Customer Care & Aftersales (CCA) Fort Worth Parts Distribution Center, 301 Freedom Dr, Roanoke TX 76262 (in the AllianceTexas logistics district NE of Fort Worth). Rooftop geocode + building footprint + web research confirm a ~404,000 sq ft GM PDC opened 2001, staffed by UAW Local 816; a 2024 TDLR-permitted ~$2.25M renovation added truck storage, paving/striping/lighting and a storm-sewer connection.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole property is enclosed by a perimeter wall/fence (visible behind the tree buffer in Freedom Dr Street View). The truck yard is reached through a single controlled entry corridor on the NW side off the access road; no open public-road curb cut into the dock yard. Set true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly staffed guard booth resolvable in satellite or the available Street View (coverage is on Freedom Dr to the east and the interior employee/office lot to the NW). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled, fenced entry with no visible manned booth -> set true (kiosk/remote check-in implied) at low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock-door bank runs the full WEST face of the building with a near-solid row of trailers backed in; ~30 trailers/doors counted across the captured tight crops -> 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer-storage rows along the west dock yard and an additional staging row off the north access drive; ~30 trailers visible with room for ~50 -> 25-50 band. The 2024 renovation explicitly added truck storage.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lanes on the west yard and north staging strip, separate from the active dock face.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved yard between the entry corridor and the dock face provides interior staging/queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the NW entry corridor down the west yard easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide west yard and north staging apron leave unused paved width for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entry corridor on the NW serves both in and out; no separate out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves off the E-W through-line along the south boundary and runs north up the WEST side of the building (confirmed in the SW Street View and z19 satellite). Set true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks are concentrated on a single (west) building face; no second distinct dock bank -> false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense AllianceTexas warehouse/logistics district off Freedom Dr with large neighboring DCs on all sides -> Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~20 acres derived from the traced perimeter ring; ~404k sq ft (~9.3 acre) building footprint plus west dock yard, north parking and east access strip.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane assumed at the controlled corridor; not separately resolvable -> uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Overhead estimate (~50) from west yard + north staging; flagged uncertain.
